# My dotfiles

All my config for my linux environment. Tools I use are listed below.

# Install
Generate a new pair of ssh keys, add them to github.
Download the [/init](init file) in this repo.

Run it, it will clone this repository and setup the dotfiles.

Now that you have all the config, command, script, ... setup, start a new shell and run ```.local/bin/setup```
It will install all the package we need


# Setup

This setup uses:

* hyprland as the window manager / compositor
* waybar as the status bar
* dunst for the notifications
* foot as the terminal
* hyprlock for the lock screen
* hyprpaper for the wallpaper
* kanshi for the screens setup
* imv for terminal image preview
* lf for a terminal file explorer
* mpv media player
* satty to edit screenshots
